I used a paired t-test on new-book prices, because each textbook has both a UCLA bookstore price and an Amazon price. Of the 68 textbooks that have both prices, the test gave t = 2.20 with 67 degrees of freedom and p ≈ 0.031. That is below 0.05, so I reject the null hypothesis of no difference in average price.

An unpaired two-sample test would give t ≈ 0.38 instead. I didn't use it because the two prices come from the same books.

ANSWER: 2.20
